_comment: Tiny docs corpus for a fictional product (Larch). Node ids are opaque; labels are breadcrumbs.

n31.label: Authentication › Overview
n31.text: Larch uses OAuth 2.0. Every API call carries a bearer access token.

n33.label: Authentication › Tokens
n33.text: Access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Expired tokens return HTTP 401 with code token_expired.

n35.label: Authentication › Refresh
n35.text: To refresh an access token, POST the refresh_token to /oauth/token with grant_type=refresh_token.

n58.label: API › Sessions
n58.text: Sessions are bound to one refresh token. Revoking the session revokes its tokens.

n70.label: Account › Password
n70.text: To reset your password, open Settings › Security and choose Reset password. A link is emailed.

n72.label: Account › Email
n72.text: Password reset emails come from no-reply@larch.example and expire after 24 hours.

n90.label: Billing › Payments
n90.text: Payments are declined when the card issuer refuses the charge or the billing address does not match.
